predictions: Ok, back to a little better last week, with a 17-8 record. Not some record or something, but after having a losing record the week before, this feels waaaay better. And as per usual, it could have been so much better with just a few wire-crossings… I lost a tiebreaker (that I actually predicted as a tiebreaker, just with the others winning!), three 13-11s, and two 14-10s. So close yet again. I guess that's just how this goes here in very well-balanced RDL-land. Thanks, Membership Director…

Match of the week: (F Div.) Bottoms Up @ Duck Duck Groove. Bottoms Up already dropped one to the other of the current 'big three' in F, but other than that, this duo has been perfect so far. Odds are high that the Ducks will be in first next week either way due to their point lead, but I think they'll 'more in first' with this Duck win, 14-10.

Match #2: (E Div.) Dirty Darts Done Dirt Cheap @ Rippin Darts. As we all know from what I've written from week 1 through now, I expect Dirty Darts to take control of this division and calmly beat it into submission. And here we are in week 5, and tonight's opponent is already the only team within one loss of them. Until now. Dirty, 16-8.

Match #3: (A Div.) Talladega Flights @ Dart Attack. There are currently four 2-loss teams in A that at first glance look to be fighting for 3rd place. But when things all settle out, I'm pretty sure this pairing is the 'actual' fight for 3rd (and that's 3rd best in the entire RDL, mind you). I expect this to be a really exciting slugfest. Talladega, 13-11.

Match #4: (B Div.) Raging Bulls Eyes @ Consistently Inconsistent. Darty certainly looks strong in their lead B position, but both of these teams have enough talent to be the one to take them down. But if they want that potential upset to eventually matter, they really have to win these matches against other top chase teams. Inconsistent, 14-10.

Match #5: (C Div.) Mulligan's Mafia @ The Outlaws. The Outlaws sit alone atop C, but when looking at those standings, note that every single C team is losing at least 10 points per match. Every. C. Team. Translation? Nearly nothing comes easy in C. And this match fits that description completely. The Outlaws win…and it won't be easy… 13-11.

Match #6: (G Div.) 21 Dart Salute @ I Got Your 6. Your 6 lost a tight one to The Dartifacts last week, and that means they are the only one of the top five who now doesn't sit at 3-1. But Your 6's point total means they are still right in the fight and this is a huge pairing. And I think they get the upset(?) over Salute to continue on, 14-10.

Matches #7, #8 & #9: (E Div.) Death Throw @ Sharky's Machine; Runs with Corks @ Cheap Shots; Bangin The Wire @ She-nanigans. The top two in E square off in match #2, leaving the other six (who are separated by only one match plus points) to pair up in what is likely two races at once - the race to see who is the top chase team, and the race to see who avoids falling to F next season. The best part of this six-pack of teams is that it's not even clear which teams are in which of those two races yet! Death Throw finally ends its yo-yo-string with a 2nd straight win, 14-10; I'll guess Cork brings a full roster and wins, 14-10; and Bangin's hot streak continues, 15-9.

Match #10: (D Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Red-eye Rangers. With the top two in D two matches up on the rest, there might only be enough time left for maybe one team to make a serious run at catching them. The Rangers have the pole position in that task, and they win, 14-10.

Match #11: (C Div.) Village Idiots @ Nine Lives. The Idiots sit right behind The Outlaws, while the Niners are currently in the #5 slot. But as noted in match #5, nothing in C comes easily, and just about all teams are still contenders. To that point, Niners win, 13-11.
Match #12: (F Div.) That's What She Said @ Nein Mark. The other winner of the Match of the Week is right here… one of the teams ahead of She Said HAS to lose. She Said handles their own, 14-10.
And the remaining 13 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Brave the Elements 16, Show Me Your Tips 8.
B Division: Darty 16, In The Hall 8; Hump! 15, Sam's Brother's 9.
C Division: Darty Sanchez 14, One Armed Bandits 10.
D Division: Rif Raf 14, Dart Side of the Moon 10; Irish Ton 13, Menace 2 Sobriety 11; Wing & A Plaque 15, Liquor Possee 9.
F Division: Armed 14, Shark Shooters 10; Sofa 15, Coach's 9.
G Division: Heart of Dartness 14, Triple Shot 10; Dartifacts 16, Bright side of Flights 8; Dart Knights 14, We Shorthand It 8.
